groups.heading: OPTIONAL SOURCE DEPTH
items: Old NCERT is especially useful because it shows that the Revolution rested not only
on elite thinkers but also on workers, artisans, peasants and the Paris crowd .
CAUTION: This is important in mains answers: do not write the event as if pamphlets alone toppled the old regime.
Old NCERT states that the Jacobins believed in direct democracy and, fearing danger to the Revolution, adopted harsh measures.

groups.heading: ADVANCED DEBATE
items: It also notes that in 14 months around 17,000 people were tried and executed.
Under the Jacobin constitution, old NCERT highlights universal male political rights, the right
of insurrection, and the principle that government must provide work or livelihood.
CAUTION: Therefore the Terror cannot be dismissed as mere madness

groups.heading: LEGACY / NUANCE
